subject: Developer demo request — integrating Redwood inference
messages:
From: Evelyn Zhang <evelyn@forgeops.io>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Developer demo request — integrating Redwood inference

Hi Ben,

I hit the developer docs quickstart CTA and wanted to follow up directly. My team at ForgeOps is evaluating options to serve LLM-based assistants in our ops product — low-latency streaming is a hard requirement and we care about private deployment options. We walked through the quickstart and got a good sense of the runtime, but we need a technical demo to validate end-to-end latency and to discuss deployment patterns (VPC + KMS).

What we can share: a short tech brief attached (current infra, key throughput targets, sample prompt patterns).

Attendees from our side: me (lead engineer), Marco (backend), and Dana (infra lead). Pref times: Tue/Wed next week mornings PST (10:00–12:00 PT) or Thu afternoon. Prefer a hands-on walk where an engineer can try connecting and run a small load test.

Can you point me to available slots or your engineer who can run the demo?

Thanks —
Evelyn
Evelyn Zhang
Senior Platform Engineer, ForgeOps
E: evelyn@forgeops.io
A: 234 Market St, SF

Attachment: forgeops_requirements.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Zhang <evelyn@forgeops.io>
Cc: ava_chen@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Developer demo request — integrating Redwood inference

Thanks for the note, Evelyn — really appreciate the detailed brief. I’ve looped in Ava (SDR) to lock down the meeting time and Marissa (SE) to run the technical walkthrough and the live connect.

Quick questions up front so Marissa can prepare the right environment:
- Do you need on-prem / air-gapped demonstration or will a VPC-hosted sandbox suffice?
- Expected sustained throughput (tokens/sec) and typical request size (avg tokens per request)?

We have a few slots next week: Tue 2027-02-16 10:30 PT, Wed 2027-02-17 11:00 PT, Thu 2027-02-18 14:00 PT. If none of those work, paste a couple of windows and Ava will send a calendar invite.

If you’d like to self-schedule, here’s my quick booking link: https://cal.com/ben/redwood-demo — pick the "Engineer-led technical demo (30m)" slot and Ava will confirm.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Ben Carter
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Hi Ben / Ava / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick reply — appreciate the options. Wed 2027-02-17 at 11:00 PT would work best for us, but can we shift that to 11:30 PT? Marco has a conflict that morning. If 11:30 doesn’t work for Marissa, we can take Thu 14:00 PT.

Also, for the sandbox, a VPC-hosted sandbox is fine. We’ll want to test an end-to-end connection (tokenized prompts + streaming) and run a short throughput exercise (5–10 concurrent requests).

Let me know which time you confirm and any pre-reqs for the connect (SSH keys, temporary credentials, allowed IPs).

—Evelyn

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Confirmed: Technical demo (Redwood) — Wed 2027-02-17 11:30 PT

Hi Evelyn — thanks for confirming. Wed 2027-02-17 11:30 PT is confirmed. I’ve attached the calendar invite and included a Zoom link and the run-of-show below. Marissa will lead the demo and give you an environment to run the brief throughput test.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/xxxxxxxxxx (passcode: demo123)
Run-of-show (30m):
- 0–5m: intros & goals (Ben + Evelyn)
- 5–20m: Marissa — live connect to VPC sandbox, streaming demo, KV cache overview
- 20–28m: short throughput exercise (5 concurrent connections, sample prompts)
- 28–30m: next steps & mutual action plan

Pre-reqs:
- Please provide the IP allowlist for the test endpoint at least 24h prior (or we can open a short-lived SSH tunnel).
- If you use an allowlist, send IPs to infra@redwood.ai.
- Sample prompt set is helpful; use the quickstart tests if convenient: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart

Attachment: demo-invite.ics (text/calendar)

See you then —
Ava Chen
SDR, Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.ai
